-- PostgreSQL sample CREATE TABLE users ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES ('alice') RETURNING id; SELECT u.id, u.name FROM users u WHERE u.name ILIKE 'a%' AND u.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT 10; SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM now()), CAST(id AS TEXT) FROM users;
